skills.name: export-table
skills.proposal: description: Export a table from the local SQLite database to a file. Use when the owner asks for a data export.
skills.why_not_covered: No installed skill exports local database tables.

skills.name: notes-to-pdf
skills.proposal: description: Turn markdown notes into a PDF and open it. Use when the owner asks for a PDF of notes.
skills.why_not_covered: No installed skill converts notes to PDF.

skills.name: deploy-and-tag
skills.proposal: description: Build and deploy the worker, check its health, then tag the release. Use when the owner asks to deploy.
skills.why_not_covered: The wrangler skill documents commands but does not run a deploy with a health check and tag.

skills.name: apply-migration
skills.proposal: description: Apply a new database migration, run the tests and commit. Use when the owner adds a migration.
skills.why_not_covered: The supabase skill covers the platform, not this apply-test-commit routine.

skills.name: review-and-merge-pr
skills.proposal: description: Review an open pull request, run the tests and merge it when they pass. Use when the owner asks to review and merge a PR.
skills.why_not_covered: code-review reviews a diff but never runs the tests or merges.
